articles.title: Days after NSA’s visit to Isro centre, space minister rules out sabotage in PSLV failures
articles.summary: Following the National Security Advisor's visit to ISRO, the Space Minister has definitively ruled out sabotage as the cause for recent PSLV (Polar Satellite Launch Vehicle) failures. This statement clarifies the nature of setbacks in India's critical space missions, reassuring national security concerns and reinforcing the technical integrity behind ISRO's operational challenges, while highlighting the nation's close scrutiny of its strategic space assets.

articles.title: Sun releasing powerful solar flares since Feb 1, space agencies on alert
articles.summary: The Sun has been emitting powerful solar flares since February 1st, prompting space agencies worldwide to be on alert. These intense solar events are being closely monitored due to their potential to impact satellite communications, power grids, and GPS systems on Earth, which are crucial for various modern operations, including defence and navigation. Aspirants should note the importance of space weather.

articles.title: 5th-gen fighter project: HAL out of race due to 'large order book'; Tata, L&T, Bharat Forge left in fray
articles.summary: India's ambitious 5th-generation fighter project is moving forward, with Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) exiting the race due to its extensive current order book. This development leaves major private sector players like Tata, Larsen & Toubro (L&T), and Bharat Forge as the primary contenders. The initiative highlights India's commitment to indigenous defence manufacturing and increasing private industry participation in critical military projects.

articles.title: Ministry of Defence of Russian Federation holds regular meeting of Russian-Cambodian workgroup on military cooperation
articles.summary: On February 3, 2026, Russia's Ministry of Defence hosted a regular meeting with Cambodia, focusing on military cooperation. These discussions underline strengthening defence ties between Russia and Southeast Asian nations. Such bilateral engagements are vital for regional security and strategic partnerships, offering SSB aspirants insights into global defence diplomacy and international relations.
